# Study questionnaire {#sec-appendixquestionnaire}


```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}



targets::tar_read(questionnaire_text) |>
  gt::gt( groupname_col = "variable") |>
  gt::cols_label(
      question_en = "",
      answer_en = "",
      question_sp = "",
      answer_sp = ""
  ) |>
  gt::opt_horizontal_padding(scale = 3) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(size =  "x-large", align = "left", color = "grey", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    row_group.padding = 20,
    row_group.border.top.width = 0,
    row_group.border.bottom.width = 1,
    table_body.hlines.width = 0,
    table_body.border.top.width = 0,
    table_body.border.bottom.width = 0,
    table.font.size = 13,
    data_row.padding = 2,
    table.border.bottom.width = 0, 
    table.border.top.width = 0,
    column_labels.border.top.width = 0,
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = 0
  )
```
